patches.title: Strip credentials from CURLINFO_EFFECTIVE_URL
patches.description: Backport upstream credential removal for effective URLs after .netrc authentication and redirects.

dep3.origin: Manual context port of upstream commit 7a6bd027d0de2b6857472d35da090ef60cc29f19; zero-fuzz application verified against Debian Trixie curl 8.14.1-2+deb13u7.

tests.baselineExpectation: With a local 301 redirect and .netrc fixture, exact installed vulnerable curl returns an effective URL containing the fixture credentials.
tests.patchedExpectation: The same transfer succeeds and reports the final URL without user or password components.

patches.title: Free deeply nested MIME structures without recursion
patches.description: Port upstream iterative curl_mime_free cleanup to Debian Trixie and retain upstream test 3595.

dep3.origin: Manual context and allocator port of upstream commit d7546809d5bd548b69ec49fca26565c8f6f0d344; Trixie source uses free() and a different test registration list.

tests.baselineExpectation: With a 64 KiB child stack, the exact installed vulnerable Trixie libcurl frees depth 50 successfully but is signaled during curl_mime_free at depth 2000 after confirming the tree was constructed.
tests.patchedExpectation: The exact same installed patched libcurl returns successfully at depth 2000, with the depth-50 control unchanged.
